new_candidates.body:
Hi organizers,

Our team's pai-warmup and pai submissions were both accepted before the deadline, but they are currently at queue positions 29 and 30 of 30.

Based on the leaderboard timestamps, evaluations appear to run one at a time, so the queue is unlikely to clear before the deadline.

1. Will submissions queued before the deadline still be evaluated after it passes?
2. If so, will they count as final-container candidates?
3. Is there an estimated time for when the queue will clear?

Thanks!
